title: CGI Foundations
description: The shared starting point for every DART pathway: the concepts and workflows of computer-generated imagery, from modeling and texturing to lighting, camera and rendering, practiced on two subjects and brought together in a final project.
text:
cgi foundations is where every dart pathway starts. you will learn how 3d images are made, from polygons to pixels, and practice each stage of the pipeline twice: once on an airline chair a room. ends with project that brings modeling, texturing, lighting rendering together in work your own.
after foundations
foundations prerequisite for other pathway. next run 303, choose fits interests, or explore them now plan ahead.
